# Logo

`logo.svg` is an original pixel-style drawing for GDP for Rust. The ghost carrying a checked document is inspired by [gdp-ts](https://github.com/rauchg/gdp-ts). Small orange pincers give it a Rust crab flavor. The drawing does not reuse upstream pixels or the Rust gear emblem.

The logo is available under the repository's MIT or Apache 2.0 license. This project is independent of gdp-ts and the Rust project.
